name: Bharati Scheme for Education - 1st Class to 5th Class
_eligibility_text:
1. The student and his/her parents should belong to the Brahmin community.  
1. The student should be studying in Andhra Pradesh.
1. The student's parents/guardians should reside in Andhra Pradesh. 
1. The annual family income of parents/guardians should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 
1. The student under the category of orphan, differently abled (physically handicapped), or children of single parents' priority will be given. 
1. The student should be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS). 
1. The student should not have availed himself/ herself of any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose.  However, students availing benefit from Archaka Welfare Trust are eligible under this scheme.
